## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue; limitations and failure behavior documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass twice; counts and skips reported.
- [ ] Required CI checks pass; no failure hidden behind a skip.
- [ ] README/reference docs and changelog match user-visible changes.
- [ ] Secrets/artifacts scan reviewed; generated binaries/data excluded.
- [ ] Compatibility, security impact and rollback described below.
